descriptions: The outfit consists of a grey blazer with a fitted cut and two-button closure, featuring a straight neckline and long sleeves. The blazer is worn over a black lace-trimmed top. The pants are high-waisted, wide-leg, and flared, matching the grey blazer in color and fabric. A black and beige striped scarf is draped over the left arm, held by the hand. The shoes are black with pointed toes and a slight heel. A black handbag with a gold clasp is carried in the right hand. The jewelry includes a silver choker necklace.

Yellow ribbed knit turtleneck sweater, fitted with a high neckline. Cream-colored oversized trench coat, worn open with wide sleeves. High-waisted burgundy shorts, fitted with button closure and straight cut. Black ribbed knit thigh-high socks. Black high-heeled ankle boots with platform sole. Maroon leather shoulder bag with a large bow on the side. Gold chain necklace.

A green ribbed knit sleeveless high-neck top, fitted. A white ruffled multi-layered maxi skirt with a flared wide-leg shape and a high waist. A tan oversized long-sleeve jacket with buttoned cuffs and an open front, worn over the top. Thick black ankle-length socks. Black platform ankle boots with a high heel and a chunky sole. A small black and white plaid bag with a chain strap, gold hardware and a round charm. A long cream scarf with fringed edges, wrapped around the neck. A short gold chain necklace.

A red cable knit sweater with an oversized fit, long sleeves, and a high neckline. The sweater has a ribbed knit texture and a diamond quilt pattern. Dark high-waisted jeans with a straight cut and wide-leg fit, featuring gold buttons and a black leather shoulder bag with a black strap. Black platform boots with lace-up fronts and chunky soles. The bag has a gold ring on the strap.

A beige trench coat with wide sleeves and a belted waist, open in the front. Underneath, a fitted plaid dress with a deep V-neckline and a small bow at the waist. The dress features a brown, black, and gray plaid pattern. The coat has a satin-like sheen and the dress has a slightly textured fabric. The legs are covered in sheer black tights. Shoes are black loafers with a glossy finish. A small, plaid-patterned handbag with a chain strap is slung over the right shoulder. A beige and brown striped scarf is tied around the neck, with one end hanging down the left side. The trench coat has button closures on the cuffs and the belt has a small buckle.

A dark brown, ribbed knit, long-sleeve top with a fitted cut and square neckline, featuring puffed sleeves and a bow-tied front. The top has a ribbed texture with subtle vertical lines. The high-waisted pants are made of maroon, pinstriped fabric with a wide-leg cut. They have a button and zipper closure at the front. The shoes are dark brown platform heels with chunky soles and gold buckles. The bag is a dark brown leather handbag with gold hardware, featuring a large bow on one side. The hat is a small, dark brown beret.

The outfit consists of a golden satin mini dress with a fitted cut and square neckline, long sleeves, and a slight ruched texture. The dress has a shiny, smooth texture. The legwear is gray opaque tights. The shoes are knee-high brown leather boots with a slight heel and a glossy finish. A brown leather shoulder bag with a gold chain strap is slung over the right shoulder. The jewelry includes a simple gold necklace.

The outfit includes a beige trench coat with black buttons and epaulettes, worn open. The coat has a long, straight cut and falls to mid-calf. Underneath, a dark brown, ribbed knit dress fits closely to the body, high-waisted with a straight cut. The neckline is crew neck. The sleeves of the coat are long and have buttoned cuffs. The dress has a subtle sheen and vertical ribbed texture. The legs are covered in black, opaque tights. On the feet, there are tan, fur-lined Ugg-style boots with a thick sole. A small, brown leather handbag with a gold chain strap hangs from the right shoulder. Around the neck, there is a thin, gold necklace with a small pendant.

A brown ribbed knit oversized hooded top with a zipper front, high neckline, long sleeves, brown buttons and a gold zipper, with a small chain necklace. Cream-colored high-waisted wide-leg straight-leg pants with a front button fly and brown buttons, fitted at the waist and flared at the bottom. Brown flat loafers with a slight shine. A brown leather shoulder bag with a leopard print pattern and a brown strap. A small chain necklace.

The outfit consists of a brown, long, wide-leg trench coat with large, flap pockets and gold buttons. The coat is worn over a brown, fitted, ruffled dress with a belted waist and a button-down front. A light pink scarf is draped around the neck. The dress has multiple ruffled layers and a flared skirt. The legs are covered in sheer, dark brown tights. The shoes are black, high-heeled ankle boots with a shiny finish. A brown, quilted, leather handbag with a gold chain strap is carried over the right shoulder.

The outfit consists of a grey ribbed knit turtleneck sweater with a high neckline and oversized, puffed sleeves. The sweater is fitted at the waist and hips. The skirt is black, high-waisted, and fitted with vertical ribbed patterns, extending to mid-calf length. A black leather handbag with a gold buckle is slung over the right shoulder. The footwear is black, high-heeled ankle boots with a slight platform and a sleek, shiny finish.

The outfit includes a grey ribbed knit tank top with a fitted cut, a low neckline, and long, wide sleeves with ruffled cuffs. The top has a small bow at the neckline. The pants are black, wide-leg, and high-waisted with a drawstring tie at the waist. They are loose-fitting and have a slight flare at the bottom. The shoes are black with a simple design and a slight heel. A black shoulder bag with a strap hangs on the right side. The accessories include a pair of black, round sunglasses on the head. The overall color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of grey and black.

The coat is worn open. Dark brown, sheer pantyhose cover the legs. Brown, high-heeled, platform ankle boots with chunky heels and ankle straps complete the look. A brown, leather, drawstring bag with a bow detail hangs from the left shoulder. The head is adorned with a gold hairpin featuring a small, yellow ribbon.

The shoes are brown, high-heeled ankle boots with platform soles. A small, quilted, dark brown handbag with a gold clasp and chain strap hangs from the right hand.
